name: Saitama Yamiko
source:
Yamiko is the cousin of [url=/c4736]Kyouji's[/url] mother, serving as a legal guardian in place of his parents. She is an accomplished though somewhat obscure occultist, and works as a leading editor of ABRAZE: an underground magazine devoted to revealing legitimate supernatural activity that the government contends does not exist.

[From Eroge Review]
